reserveReview.rationale: At BSC block 125575999, hash 0x327f084fa5a602e38c79502d4c76940648243aa5a8c3ed821ec96cdd1cbafaab, the exact wrapper's sUSDC() is 0xc603ef9cab5e4131c52f6b8bcf06cc0568c32a24 and spusd() is the cataloged SPUSD token. Same-block SPUSD totalSupply is 38442789346502623719581073 base units, while sUSDC.balanceOf(wrapper) is 56801435321189845501586244. Both nonproxy SPUSD and wrapper runtimes exactly match Sourcify's verified onchainBytecode. The wrapper's two mint paths transfer the same amount of the single immutable sUSDC receipt before minting SPUSD; its ordinary unwrap returns that receipt, not USDC. The 100% row therefore records the observed immediate receipt backing claim, without valuing excess receipts as additional collateral or treating cumulative USDC deposit counters as assets. Token role administrators can authorize additional minting; no immutable collateral-gating finding is made. All underlying strategy/treasury and BSC-USDC representation look-through remains an explicit 100% insufficient-evidence remainder. No native Circle USDC identity, Venus allocation percentage, current full underlying portfolio, or canonical escrow is asserted.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current pinned immediate-receipt inventory: one immutable sUSDC claim per SPUSD, with measured wrapper receipt balance exceeding the entire observed SPUSD token-unit denominator; unresolved full look-through retained
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: 100% of SPUSD's identified immediate sUSDC receipt backing lacks a verified complete underlying strategy/treasury book and canonical BSC-USDC escrow correspondence. The entire receipt remains an explicit insufficient-evidence residual, not native USDC or a proved Venus allocation.
